top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, independently replicated discovery chain: human incretin physiology (Holst), proglucagon processing and GLP-1 receptor biology (Drucker), and identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov). It is mature, with about three decades of confirmation and outcome-trial support, and the three-person allocation fits within the limit. The Mojsov/Habener priority question and the exclusion of Knudsen are real weaknesses, but a citation worded around physiology and the active form keeps the award on discovery, so I still prefer it to no award.
